explanation.definitionFit: Joyce Carol Oates's novel of Detroit life has this pronoun as its title, and Brock kills Bernie in its opening chapters.

clue.text: Mouthy star upset poor girl who loved Winterborne

explanation.definitionFit: In Hardy's The Woodlanders the humble Marty South loves Giles Winterborne, who loves Grace Melbury instead.

explanation.definitionFit: Wells's ghost story is set in Lorraine Castle, and its title is the haunted chamber there.
